releaseNotes: Original-X4 speed and daily UX: usable Library results during discovery, 24-record RAM pages over a temporary SD view beyond 150 books, title/author search, Title/Author/Recent sorting and selective refresh after file changes. Anki fetches and grade saves use one owned worker; fetch cancellation stays responsive while the current request finishes, grades remain serialized and uncertain saves are not blindly retried. Ink-style Home, nested Tools navigation, button guide, cloze/media safeguards and reading statistics retained. Simulator smoke, 26 Anki tests, 200-book paging/search, delayed cancellation, grade/exit and original-X4 production build passed. Physical acceptance pending.
